source_title: India vs New Zealand 3rd T20I live streaming: When and where to watch IND vs NZ live on TV and online? - The Times of India
source_excerpt: India will look to seal the five-match T20I series when they take on New Zealand in the third match at Hnry Stadium in Wellington on Tuesday, October 27. Having won the opening two games, the visitors hold a 2-0 lead and need just one more victory to clinch the series.The Suryakumar Yadav-led side edged past New Zealand in both matches, with the second T20I producing another close finish. India chased down a target of 181 runs to secure a four-run victory, with Tilak Varma playing a match-winning knock of an unbeaten 51 off 26 balls.While India's batting has delivered under pressure, the bowling unit will be keen to produce a more disciplined performance after conceding substantial runs in the first two games.
